import hashlib, json, os, pathlib, re, shutil, subprocess, tempfile, time

ROOT = pathlib.Path('/home/codex/.codex/worktrees/46be/Proofs')
BASE = ROOT/'Computability/DiophantineConsistency/Lean'
PARENT = pathlib.Path('/tmp/thirteen-sphere96-author-bjabhjsi/inputs.json')
NAMES = ['DiophantineConsistency.NearSquareNormZero',
         'DiophantineConsistency.NearSquareNormZeroChecks']

def require(ok, message):
    if not ok:
        raise RuntimeError(message)

def sha(p):
    return hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()

parent = json.loads(PARENT.read_text())
require(sha(parent['compiler']['path']) == parent['compiler']['sha256'], 'compiler drift')
external = parent['LEAN_PATH'][1:]
require(all('/.lake/build/lib/lean' not in x or '/.lake/packages/' in x for x in external),
        'package/toolchain boundary only')
out = pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='fourteen-nonzero-generic-'))
(out/'lib/DiophantineConsistency').mkdir(parents=True)
(out/'logs').mkdir()
sources = []
for n in NAMES:
    p = BASE/(n.replace('.', '/')+'.lean')
    sources.append({'module':n, 'path':str(p), 'sha256':sha(p)})
imports = re.findall(r'^import (\S+)', pathlib.Path(sources[0]['path']).read_text(), re.M)
package = pathlib.Path('/home/codex/src/Proofs/.lake/packages/mathlib')
roots = []
for n in imports:
    src = package/(n.replace('.', '/')+'.lean')
    obj = package/'.lake/build/lib/lean'/(n.replace('.', '/')+'.olean')
    require(src.exists() and obj.exists(), 'explicit package root absent '+n)
    roots.append({'module':n, 'source':str(src), 'source_sha256':sha(src),
                  'object':str(obj), 'object_sha256':sha(obj)})
pins = {'compiler':parent['compiler'], 'manifest_sha256':sha(ROOT/'lake-manifest.json'),
        'parent_inventory':str(PARENT), 'parent_inventory_sha256':sha(PARENT),
        'package_roots':roots, 'sources':sources, 'LEAN_PATH':[str(out/'lib')]+external,
        'scope':'Two new generic leaves only; explicit unchanged package/toolchain boundary, no native custom objects.'}
(out/'inputs.json').write_text(json.dumps(pins, indent=2)+'\n')
path = pathlib.Path('/tmp/fourteen-nonzero-generic-latest')
path.write_text(str(out)+'\n')
env = dict(os.environ, LEAN_PATH=':'.join(pins['LEAN_PATH']), LEAN_NUM_THREADS='1')
records = []
for src in sources:
    require(shutil.disk_usage('/tmp').free > 512*1024**2, '512MiB reserve')
    n = src['module']; short = n.rsplit('.', 1)[-1]
    log = out/'logs'/(short+'.log'); timing = out/'logs'/(short+'.time')
    snapshot = out/'logs'/(short+'.lean')
    snapshot.write_bytes(pathlib.Path(src['path']).read_bytes())
    target = out/'lib'/(n.replace('.', '/')+'.olean')
    cmd = [pins['compiler']['path'], '-M6000', '-j1', '-DElab.async=false',
           '-o',str(target),src['path']]
    print('START '+n, flush=True)
    start = time.monotonic()
    with log.open('w') as f:
        result = subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/time','-v','-o',str(timing)]+cmd,
            cwd=ROOT, env=env, stdout=f, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
    rec = dict(src, command=cmd, exit_code=result.returncode, seconds=time.monotonic()-start,
        log=str(log), log_sha256=sha(log), timing=str(timing), timing_sha256=sha(timing),
        snapshot=str(snapshot))
    require(sha(src['path']) == src['sha256'], 'active source drift')
    if result.returncode == 0:
        rec['object'] = {'path':str(target), 'sha256':sha(target)}
    records.append(rec)
    (out/'run.json').write_text(json.dumps(records, indent=2)+'\n')
    print(json.dumps(rec), flush=True)
    print(log.read_text(), flush=True)
    if result.returncode:
        raise SystemExit(result.returncode)
for r in roots:
    require(sha(r['source']) == r['source_sha256'] and sha(r['object']) == r['object_sha256'],
            'package root drift '+r['module'])
require(sha(pins['compiler']['path']) == pins['compiler']['sha256'], 'compiler postcheck')
print('PASS '+str(out), flush=True)

ROOT=pathlib.Path('/home/codex/.codex/worktrees/46be/Proofs')
BASE=ROOT/'Computability/DiophantineConsistency/Lean'
PARENT=pathlib.Path('/tmp/merged-native-20261026-054ycdsy')
GENERIC=pathlib.Path('/tmp/fourteen-nonzero-generic-crvs2a6x')
NAMES=['DiophantineConsistency.CarrierNonzeroSpheres','DiophantineConsistency.CarrierNonzeroSpheresChecks']
def require(ok,msg):
 if not ok:raise RuntimeError(msg)
def sha(p):return hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def pin(p):return {'path':str(p),'sha256':sha(p)}
plan=json.loads((PARENT/'plan.json').read_text());state=json.loads((PARENT/'state.json').read_text())
require(state['status']=='PASS' and sha(PARENT/'plan.json')==state['plan_sha256'],'parent terminal plan')
require(sha(plan['compiler']['path'])==plan['compiler']['sha256'],'compiler')
mods={x['module']:x for x in plan['modules']}; fresh={x['module']:x for x in state['completed']}
selected=set()
def select(n):
 if n in selected:return
 selected.add(n)
 for d in mods[n]['imports']:
  if d in mods:select(d)
select('DiophantineConsistency.CarrierScaledAuxiliary118')
out=pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='fourteen-nonzero-native-'))
lib=out/'lib';lib.mkdir();(out/'logs').mkdir()
records=[];companions=[]
for m in plan['modules']:
 n=m['module']
 if n not in selected:continue
 src=m['source'];obj=fresh[n]['object'] if n in fresh else m['object']
 require(sha(src['path'])==src['sha256'],'current source '+n)
 require(sha(obj['path'])==obj['sha256'],'authenticated object '+n)
 p=PARENT/'lib'/(n.replace('.','/')+'.olean')
 require(sha(p)==obj['sha256'],'parent resolved object '+n)
 records.append({'module':n,'source':src,'object':obj,'imports':m['imports'],
                 'origin':'parent-fresh' if n in fresh else 'parent-authenticated-reuse'})
 for p0 in sorted(p.parent.glob(p.stem+'.*')):
  if p0.is_file() and p0.suffix in ('.olean','.ilean','.ir','.private','.server'):
   q=lib/p0.relative_to(PARENT/'lib');q.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
   q.symlink_to(p0.resolve());companions.append(pin(p0))
grun=json.loads((GENERIC/'run.json').read_text());g=grun[0]
require(g['exit_code']==0 and sha(g['path'])==g['sha256'] and sha(g['object']['path'])==g['object']['sha256'],'generic frozen')
gsrc=pathlib.Path(g['object']['path'])
for p0 in sorted(gsrc.parent.glob(gsrc.stem+'.*')):
 if p0.is_file() and p0.suffix in ('.olean','.ilean','.ir','.private','.server'):
  q=lib/'DiophantineConsistency'/p0.name;q.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
  q.symlink_to(p0.resolve());companions.append(pin(p0))
sources=[{'module':n,**pin(BASE/(n.replace('.','/')+'.lean'))} for n in NAMES]
inputs={'parent_plan':pin(PARENT/'plan.json'),'parent_state':pin(PARENT/'state.json'),
        'generic_input':pin(GENERIC/'inputs.json'),'generic_run':pin(GENERIC/'run.json'),
        'generic_source':{'path':g['path'],'sha256':g['sha256']},'generic_object':g['object'],
        'compiler':plan['compiler'],'sources':sources,'selected_custom_count':len(records),
        'selected_custom':records,'companions':companions,
        'LEAN_PATH':[str(lib)]+plan['external_lean_path'],
        'scope':'Two new leaves only. Exact361-module selected parent cache plus newly checked generic lemma, not a new dependency-closure replay.'}
(out/'inputs.json').write_text(json.dumps(inputs,indent=2)+'\n')
pathlib.Path('/tmp/fourteen-nonzero-native-latest').write_text(str(out)+'\n')
env=dict(os.environ,LEAN_PATH=':'.join(inputs['LEAN_PATH']),LEAN_NUM_THREADS='1');results=[]
for s in sources:
 require(shutil.disk_usage('/tmp').free>512*1024**2,'512MiB reserve')
 short=s['module'].split('.')[-1];log=out/'logs'/(short+'.log');tm=out/'logs'/(short+'.time')
 snap=out/'logs'/(short+'.lean');snap.write_bytes(pathlib.Path(s['path']).read_bytes())
 target=lib/(s['module'].replace('.','/')+'.olean')
 command=[plan['compiler']['path'],'-M6000','-j1','-DElab.async=false','-o',str(target),s['path']]
 print('START '+s['module'],flush=True);start=time.monotonic()
 with log.open('w') as f:
  result=subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/time','-v','-o',str(tm)]+command,cwd=ROOT,env=env,stdout=f,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
 r=dict(s,command=command,exit_code=result.returncode,seconds=time.monotonic()-start,
        log=pin(log),timing=pin(tm),snapshot=pin(snap))
 require(sha(s['path'])==s['sha256'],'target source drift')
 if result.returncode==0:r['object']=pin(target)
 results.append(r);(out/'run.json').write_text(json.dumps(results,indent=2)+'\n')
 print(json.dumps(r),flush=True);print(log.read_text(),flush=True)
 if result.returncode:raise SystemExit(result.returncode)
for r in records:
 require(sha(r['source']['path'])==r['source']['sha256'],'source postcheck')
 require(sha(r['object']['path'])==r['object']['sha256'],'object postcheck')
for r in companions:require(sha(r['path'])==r['sha256'],'companion postcheck')
require(sha(inputs['compiler']['path'])==inputs['compiler']['sha256'],'compiler postcheck')
print('PASS '+str(out),flush=True)
